name: RakeshRaja Site Doctor
author: Rakesh Raja

sections.description:
This plugin adds a private admin support area with:

  • Site Health Summary checks for core updates, plugins, themes, PHP version, SSL, and debug status.
  • Request Help from Developer support form with optional screenshot upload.
  • Local log of recent support requests.
  • Floating admin button for quick access to the support form.

The support form sends data only when the user explicitly submits it.

Privacy

When the support form is used, the plugin may email the submitted details to the configured support address. The plugin stores the last 5 support request summaries locally in the database and does not sync this data to external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the Site Doctor menu in wp-admin.
sections.faq:
Does this send data automatically?

No. Data is sent only when the user explicitly submits the support form.

Does the plugin store support requests?

Yes. It stores the last 5 requests locally in the site database for the admin to review.

short_description: RakeshRaja Site Doctor provides a wp-admin support page for WordPress site owners to review basic health checks and request help from the developer.
